# Results (generated by run_all.py)

Two historical timelines are modelled: one assembled from online sources and one
following Chandler (1966). Each is calibrated separately to the same casualties.

## Calibration

| Timeline | alpha (Prussian lethality) | beta (French lethality) | French edge per man | Square-law break-even ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online sources | 0.123 | 0.196 | 1.60x | 1.26 : 1 |
| Chandler (1966) | 0.185 | 0.252 | 1.37x | 1.17 : 1 |

Prussia's overall numerical ratio: 1.83 : 1. Historical run (online timeline): Prussian army breaks at 12:30 (by construction).
